Docs/Citation

Citation

Cite the DexArena preprint and identify the source, data and model versions behind your experiment.

The benchmark reference

Cite DexArena when using its task definitions, demonstrations, evaluation protocol or reported results. The public record is the 2026 arXiv preprint, arXiv:2611.02629.

Haonan Ping, Jianshu Hu, Yimin Wang, Yi Zhu, Pai Liang, Qiyan Jin, Qirui Bao, Ying Qian, Xinyang Ding, Hongfei Qiao, Tianle Xue, Yucheng Bai, Soo Wei Jie, Shuguang Li, Yutong Ban. (2026). DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation. arXiv:2611.02629. Paper record ↗.

Open arXiv record ↗ · Read PDF ↗ · Official code ↗

Copy the BibTeX entry

The entry preserves the paper title and supplied author order. It does not assert a conference or journal acceptance.

Download .bib ↓
@misc{ping2026dexarena,
  title = {DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation},
  author = {Haonan Ping and Jianshu Hu and Yimin Wang and Yi Zhu and Pai Liang and Qiyan Jin and Qirui Bao and Ying Qian and Xinyang Ding and Hongfei Qiao and Tianle Xue and Yucheng Bai and Soo Wei Jie and Shuguang Li and Yutong Ban},
  year = {2026},
  eprint = {2611.02629},
  archivePrefix = {arXiv},
  primaryClass = {cs.RO},
  doi = {10.48550/arXiv.2611.02629},
  url = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02629}
}

Identify the artifacts used

Alongside the citation, state the arXiv version, code commit, dataset repository revision, checkpoint identity and hash, and any local modifications. For released checkpoints, distinguish the manuscript protocol from the model's release or selection protocol.

A reproducible methods section also identifies the task list, hand, controller, camera contract, episode count, seed list, horizon and scene backgrounds. Describe stage switching for complete sequences without intermediate resets.

Credit the learning methods

Cite the original algorithms and model releases used in your experiment as well as the benchmark. The training guide identifies the six baseline implementations and links to their public source guides. See the method directory for original research references.

Use the reproduction checklist before sharing results.
